concepts: Cli: Quickstart: CLI quickstart, Authentication options, Scripting and automation, Connect to a Managed Agents session, Manage resources as code, Using the CLI.

skills: Install the ant command-line tool, authenticate, and send your first request to the Claude API.
Authenticate the ant CLI with interactive login, API keys, named profiles, and Workload Identity Federation.
Version-control API resources as files with ant apply, chain ant CLI commands in scripts, operate on resources from Claude Code, and authenticate curl calls with CLI credentials.
Connect to a Managed Agents session
Attach the ant CLI to a Claude Managed Agents session to follow its transcript live, send messages, allow or deny tool calls, or open the session viewer in your browser.
Declare agents, environments, skills, memory stores, deployments, and vaults as files in your repository and keep the API's resources in sync with them using ant apply.
Command structure, output formats, GJSON transforms, request bodies, and debugging for the ant CLI.
"Official tools for building with the Claude API: client SDKs in seven languages, the ant CLI, and framework-specific libraries."
Intercept and modify the SDK's requests and responses.
Use Claude on Apple platforms through the Foundation Models framework with the Claude for Foundation Models Swift package.
Anthropic provides a compatibility layer that lets you use the OpenAI SDK to test the Claude API. With a few code changes, you can evaluate Anthropic model capabilities.
Install and configure the Anthropic C# SDK for .NET applications with IChatClient integration
Install and configure the Anthropic Go SDK with context-based cancellation and functional options
Install and configure the Anthropic Java SDK with builder patterns and async support
Install and configure the Anthropic PHP SDK with value objects and builder patterns
Install and configure the Anthropic Python SDK with sync and async client support
Install and configure the Anthropic Ruby SDK with Sorbet types, streaming helpers, and connection pooling
Install and configure the Anthropic TypeScript SDK for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and browser environments
